inter-mpc.salaryRange: Foundation stage — focus on entrance exams (JEE/EAMCET)
inter-mpc.competitiveGap: Your rank in EAMCET/JEE determines everything. Below 10k rank = limited options. Start prep now.

inter-bipc.competitiveGap: NEET is hyper-competitive (20L+ aspirants). A backup plan in B.Sc Life Sciences is essential.

inter-cec.salaryRange: Foundation stage — CA foundation / B.Com / CLAT
inter-cec.competitiveGap: CA is the gold path but has a 15% pass rate. Build a parallel plan in B.Com + GST practitioner.

inter-mec.competitiveGap: Economics Hons / BBA + data skills. Pure economics without analytics is limiting.

inter-hec.salaryRange: Foundation stage — Civil services / BA / Law
inter-hec.competitiveGap: Civil services is the dream but needs 2-3 years of dedicated prep. Start with NCERT foundation.

iti-electrical.marketDemand: High — Electrician skills always in demand, EV boost
iti-electrical.competitiveGap: NCVT certificate + wireman license is mandatory. Many skip the license and lose out on govt and industrial jobs.

iti-mechanical.marketDemand: Medium-High — Manufacturing and MSME hiring steady
iti-mechanical.competitiveGap: CNC operation + safety certification gives you a 40% salary edge. Most don't invest in these.

iti-fitter.competitiveGap: Precision measurement + blueprint reading are tested in every interview. Weak fundamentals = rejection.

iti-welder.marketDemand: High — Specialized welders earn premium in oil & gas
iti-welder.competitiveGap: 6G welding certification can triple your salary. Most stop at 3G and plateau.

iti-copa.marketDemand: High — Every office needs IT support
iti-copa.competitiveGap: Tally + Excel + basic networking. Without these, you're stuck at data entry wages.

diploma-mechanical.competitiveGap: CAD + CNC + quality control. Diploma holders without software skills lose to B.Tech freshers.

diploma-civil.competitiveGap: AutoCAD + surveying + ESTI costing. Site experience during study gives a massive head start.

diploma-cse.marketDemand: High — Junior developer / IT support roles
diploma-cse.competitiveGap: Web development portfolio + GitHub. Diploma CS without projects is the weakest position in IT.

diploma-eee.competitiveGap: PLC programming + solar installation. These practical skills convert diploma to high-paying roles.

degree-bsc.marketDemand: Medium — Needs specialization for good roles
degree-bsc.competitiveGap: M.Sc or professional certification is almost required. B.Sc alone rarely gets technical roles.

degree-bcom.competitiveGap: Tally Prime + GST + Excel + SAP FICO basics. These four skills multiply your employability 5x.

degree-ba.marketDemand: Medium — Civil services, teaching, content roles
degree-ba.competitiveGap: Digital marketing, content writing, or civil services prep. A plain BA needs a specialization add-on.

degree-bca.marketDemand: High — Software junior roles, needs portfolio
degree-bca.competitiveGap: Full-stack project portfolio + GitHub. BCA without code proof is just a certificate.

degree-bba.marketDemand: Medium — Sales, marketing, HR entry roles
degree-bba.competitiveGap: MBA or sales/CRM experience. BBA alone is too generic for specialized roles.

btech-cse.marketDemand: Very High — AI/ML, Full-stack, Cloud roles exploding
btech-cse.competitiveGap: You compete with 1.5M+ CS graduates yearly. Without 2+ real projects on GitHub and DSA fluency, you are invisible to recruiters.

btech-ece.competitiveGap: VLSI and embedded roles need hands-on with microcontrollers. Pure theory students get filtered out in technical rounds.

btech-eee.marketDemand: Medium-High — EV and renewable energy boosting roles
btech-eee.competitiveGap: Core electrical roles are shrinking. Upskilling in PLC, SCADA, or solar/EV systems is the differentiator.

btech-mechanical.marketDemand: Medium — EV, automation, robotics creating niches
btech-mechanical.competitiveGap: CAD software (SolidWorks, AutoCAD) + a physical project portfolio is what gets hired. Degrees alone don't.

btech-civil.marketDemand: Medium — Infrastructure spending steady but competitive
btech-civil.competitiveGap: AutoCAD + site experience + BIM knowledge. Without internship exposure, you start at the bottom.

btech-ds.marketDemand: Very High — Every company needs data talent
btech-ds.competitiveGap: SQL + Python + Statistics are non-negotiable. Many graduates know Python but can't write a SQL join — that eliminates them instantly.

btech-ai.competitiveGap: Most AI jobs need strong math + ML fundamentals. A course certificate alone won't land interviews — you need a published project or Kaggle rank.

inter-mpc.question: Describe a challenge you faced and how you overcame it.
inter-mpc.modelAnswer: Use STAR: Situation (context), Task (your responsibility), Action (what you did), Result (outcome with metrics). Focus on YOUR actions and the measurable result.

inter-mpc.question: Where do you see yourself in 5 years?

inter-mpc.question: Why should we hire you over other candidates?
inter-mpc.modelAnswer: Don't compare to others. State your unique value: specific skills + proven results + cultural fit. "I bring [skill] proven by [project/result], and I'm passionate about [company mission]."

iti-electrical.question: What is the function of an MCB and how does it differ from a fuse?
iti-electrical.modelAnswer: An MCB (Miniature Circuit Breaker) automatically trips during overload or short circuit, protecting the circuit. Unlike a fuse which melts and must be replaced, an MCB can be reset and reused. MCBs respond faster and are more reliable.

iti-electrical.question: Explain the difference between single-phase and three-phase supply. Which is used for what?
iti-electrical.modelAnswer: Single-phase supply is 230V with one phase and one neutral, used for domestic loads (lights, fans, small appliances). Three-phase supply is 415V with three phases, used for industrial loads (motors, heavy machinery) as it delivers more power efficiently with less conductor material.

iti-electrical.question: What safety precautions must you take before working on an electrical installation?
iti-electrical.modelAnswer: Isolate the supply by switching off the main breaker. Apply lockout/tagout. Verify the circuit is dead using a voltage tester. Wear PPE (insulated gloves, safety shoes). Ensure proper grounding. Never work on live equipment without authorization.

iti-electrical.question: What is the purpose of earthing? Name two types of earthing systems.
iti-electrical.modelAnswer: Earthing provides a low-resistance path for fault current to flow to the ground, protecting people from electric shock and equipment from damage. Two types: (1) Pipe earthing — using a GI pipe buried in ground. (2) Plate earthing — using a copper or GI plate buried in charcoal and salt layers.

iti-electrical.question: How does a transformer work? What is the turns ratio and how does it affect voltage?
iti-electrical.modelAnswer: A transformer works on mutual induction. AC current in the primary winding creates a changing magnetic flux in the core, which induces voltage in the secondary winding. The turns ratio (N2/N1) determines voltage transformation: more secondary turns = step up, fewer = step down. V2/V1 = N2/N1.

degree-bcom.modelAnswer: GST (Goods and Services Tax) is a unified indirect tax on supply of goods and services. degree-bcom.modelAnswer: The accounting equation is Assets = Liabilities + Equity. Assets are what the business owns (cash, inventory, equipment). degree-bcom.modelAnswer: Direct taxes are paid directly to the government by the person on whom it is levied — burden cannot be shifted. Examples: Income Tax, Corporate Tax. degree-bcom.question: What is depreciation? Name two methods of calculating it.
degree-bcom.modelAnswer: Depreciation is the systematic reduction in the value of a tangible asset over its useful life due to wear and tear, obsolescence, or age. degree-bcom.question: What is the difference between a balance sheet and a profit & loss account?
degree-bcom.modelAnswer: A Balance Sheet shows the financial position (assets, liabilities, equity) at a specific point in time (a snapshot). btech-cse.modelAnswer: Arrays store elements in contiguous memory allowing O(1) random access but O(n) insertion/deletion. btech-cse.modelAnswer: SQL databases are relational with fixed schemas, ACID compliance, and vertical scaling. btech-cse.modelAnswer: A hash collision occurs when two different keys map to the same index. Two strategies: (1) Chaining — store colliding elements in a linked list at that index. (2) Open addressing — probe for the next available slot using linear or quadratic probing.
